name: delegation-a-workers-read-with-command
why: The worker's read, handed on by an approval, with the command the approving discobox's credential was allowed for (ADR 26-09-30-854 §2).

purposes: read-only GitHub access to issues and their comments in discobox-ai/discobox (gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/N and issues/N/comments), for the discoboxes I create
uses: Read issues #51 and #42 (and their comments and linked sibling sub-issues) in discobox-ai/discobox with gh issue view / gh api GET
facts: Discobox allowed this credential, for the request being judged, to the command: discobox secret request approve sreq_8m2kd0w4tq7yh3nc
